name: Vector Dot-Product Isomorphism
description: I replaced the direct "different mode" graph-coloring condition with a discrete vector assignment problem. By mapping the 3 choices to specific 3D vectors (weight 2, pairwise overlap 1) and requiring their dot product to be exactly 1, the condition becomes perfectly isomorphic to "distinct choices". Models relying on surface pattern matching will likely misinterpret this as an algebraic or continuous constraint system, failing to recognize the simple 3-coloring backtracking structure and missing the natural DFS optimization.
